name: sample
description: Tiny committed surfacing-replay session: two prompts memory should speak up about, one weak-match prompt it must stay quiet about, and one structural non-prompt. The weak turn's only term is hyphenated ('billing-migration'), so the keyword lane retrieves the billing rows while the graded key reads zero substring coverage - the calibrated floor abstains and a permissive zero floor false-fires. Note paths stay under Brain/ because that is the tree the shipped indexer walks.

notes.body: The Atlas launch checklist is owned by Marco. The billing migration finishes before the launch freeze in March.
